text:
Rosa D: Hey team — new dev trying the quickstart sample (Python). First run returned a reply and I thought I was good, but the next 3 runs got 402 billing_required. Strange. Anyone seen first-success then immediate gating?
Tim H: Which sample and key? workspace or personal?
Rosa D: Python quickstart from docs: `pip install redwood-inference` snippet. Using key from workspace `ws_rosa_sales`.
Rosa D: Code I ran:
```py
from redwood import Redwood
client = Redwood(api_key=os.getenv('RW_KEY'))
print(client.generate('hi'))
```
Rosa D: First run printed text and returned quickly. Next runs fail with: `RequestError: 402 billing_required` and body `{\"error\":\"billing.required\",\"message\":\"Enable billing to use API\"}`
Nadia P: SDK doesn't auto-retry 402. If the activation is async the UI can be optimistic. Do you see "API access: enabled" in workspace settings?
Rosa D: The console showed a green "API enabled" toast after I clicked the toggle. But settings still showed `api_access: false` in the debug JSON.
infra-bot: Found job 90122 for ws_rosa_sales: action=enable_api, started=1765205500, state=failed, reason=backend-rate-limit. Retries attempted: 2.
billing-bot: Billing record ws_rosa_sales: payment_method=card-unset, trial_credits=0, api_access=false. Last invoice attempt 1765205400.
Tim H: Looks like UI confirmed but worker failed to flip flag. Two paths: (1) manual flip via billing admin (fast) or (2) requeue job with exponential backoff. Will do quick flip if you want unblock.
Rosa D: Please flip — I'm onboarding for a demo in 30m.
Nadia P: Filing a small docs tweak: include an explicit step to confirm the workspace API access flag and show the exact error text to look for. Also add a note that first call success can be misleading.
Tim H: Done — I set api_access=true for ws_rosa_sales and requeued job 90122 with backoff. Confirmed in billing ledger.
billing-bot: Billing status ws_rosa_sales: api_access=true, payment_method=card-unset, status=active.
Rosa D: Re-ran quickstart — now consistent 200s. First successful call for real this time. :tada:
Rosa D: Quick feedback for docs: (a) mention the workspace debug JSON path for `api_access`, (b) show the sample error body so users can triage faster, (c) small healthcheck script in quickstart that fails on 4xx instead of printing sample text.
Docs-Squad: Thanks — creating PR to add a small troubleshooting section and healthcheck snippet. Will also add a line about the async activation UX.
Nadia P: Follow-ups: add trace id in UI toast, surface pending state in console, and have onboarding job use jittered backoff.
Rosa D: Great — thanks for the quick help, saved my demo! :)
